content:  For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 32 to 127 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and  for Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 and StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTi meMaster equals True ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ) the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation that has been set by StbM_SetRateCorrection() for that Time Base. If no rate deviation has been set, StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .
